title: Calculations Engine Demo
heygenScriptShort: This is our FHA Streamline Loan Amount worksheet — spreadsheet logic wired through one shared Calculations Engine with DAG-lite. Change an additional amount and G15 through G30 cascade automatically — no hand-wired listeners. Pure math lives in calcMath; bindings live in calculationEngine.js. Open the worksheet below to see one keystroke update the whole chain.
